objective.quality_requirement: Preserve exact target/emitted-token equivalence, complete request ownership, and prompt/completion/cache accounting.
objective.latency_tradeoff: Retain any valid positive exact endpoint change; do not impose a per-project percentage gate.

bench.resident_state: Exact checkpoint, pinned image, source and CUDA caches warm; no server or experiment process resident.

first_scientific_arms: One exact stock c32 endpoint control with 32 complete requests and output length 358.
One exact candidate c32 endpoint using only the hash-bound scheduler/graph-gap source intervention.
mutable_checks: Source/build/import/path/permission and process-local attachment defects before request submission.
One cached server replacement when needed to install the same hash-bound source.
prohibited: Changing model, checkpoint, image, workload packet, output length, or request ownership.
